title: Optimization-based One-side Boundary Control of LWR Traffic Models
summary: In this paper, we study the feasibility of a class of optimization-based boundary control of one-dimensional macroscopic traffic flow models, where stability and invariance are achieved by a single boundary control. We define the sets of controllers to stabilize the system to a desired state via Lyapunov functionals, and to ensure forward invariance of a desired subset via boundary control barrier functionals.
